描述_EN: rhinoceros horn was usually employed to make drinking cups and it is rare to find a bowl made of this material. rhinoceros horn also appealed to collectors for its tactile qualities, and this bowl shows signs of having been handled repeatedly. the colour of this piece is particularly fine - a warm brown streaked with black.
描述_ZN: 犀牛角通常被用来制作酒杯，用这种材料制作的碗很罕见。 犀牛角也因其触觉质量而吸引了收藏家，这只碗有被反复处理过的痕迹。 这件作品的颜色特别好--温暖的棕色，上面有黑色的条纹。
